# Workspace Notes

- This is a React + TypeScript + Vite fundraiser demo. Use `npm run dev`, `npm run build`, and `npm run lint`.
- Main campaign and admin UI live in `src/App.tsx`; design rules live in `src/App.css` and `src/index.css`.
- Contribution data and receipt images currently use browser localStorage only. Do not treat this implementation as secure or as a real payment processor.
- The poster is `public/horus-poster.jpg`; organizer portrait paths are `public/organizer-01.jpg` through `public/organizer-03.jpg`. Confirm organizer names and campaign facts before launch.
